request.style: English, triumphant cinematic anthem, massive symphonic choir with men and women answering each other, brass fanfares, pounding timpani, full orchestra, victorious major key, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The earth is the Lord's and all it holds
The world and all who live in it
For he founded it upon the seas
And set it firm upon the waters

[Chorus]
Lift up your heads, you gates
Be lifted up, you ancient doors
That the King of glory may come in

[Verse]
Who is this King of glory
The Lord, strong and mighty
The Lord, mighty in battle
Who is he, this King of glory

[Chorus]
Lift up your heads, you gates
Be lifted up, you ancient doors
That the King of glory may come in

[Outro]
The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory
